text:
Alicia P.: Quick check — I'm adding an interface VPC endpoint in prod for the partner ingestion pipeline so we can stop NAT egress. Need a security quick-check: do we need any route table changes? Will VPC Flow Logs capture S3 object keys or other PII? Also, can we reuse the existing endpoint SG or should we create a dedicated one? Terraform snippet below.

Jamal: You shouldn’t need route table changes for Interface endpoints — they create ENIs in the subnets. Make sure source/dest check is disabled on the ENI. Flow Logs capture network metadata (src/dst IP, ports, bytes) but not S3 object keys. Any object keys would appear in application-level logs, not VPC Flow Logs.

Riley: +1. For SGs, prefer a dedicated SG that only allows TLS (443) from the partner CIDR(s). Reusing a shared SG increases blast radius. Also ensure the endpoint policy limits which principals can use the endpoint.

Maya: From compliance: confirm that downstream logs the partner gets do not include unredacted headers or object keys. If the partner legitimately needs object keys, we need a signed data-sharing addendum.

Alicia P.: Terraform snippet I'm planning to apply:
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "partner_ep" {
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.vpce.us-west-2.vpce-svc-xxxx"
  vpc_endpoint_type = "Interface"
  subnet_ids = var.ingestion_subnets
  security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.partner_ep_sg.id]
}
```
Any objections?

devops-bot: plan from alicia-p pushed: `terraform plan` shows add 1 vpc endpoint, 1 security group

sec-bot: quick-static-check: endpoint policy missing explicit deny for external principals. Recommend adding an endpoint policy that only allows our account and the partner IAM principal/ARN. Marking thread as 'needs-policy-update'.

Jamal: I'll drop a patch to attach a restrictive endpoint policy and create a SG rule template restricting to partner CIDR. Assigning to @Jamal, ETA EOD.

Alicia P.: thanks — please ping when ready. If we have policy + dedicated SG, I'll proceed with apply during the maintenance window.

Maya: Approving from compliance for a dev/prod deploy as long as the policy and SG template are applied. :white_check_mark:

Jamal: uploaded patch: https://git.company/repo/infra/commit/abc123 — added endpoint policy + SG rules. Please test in staging.

Alicia P.: ran staging tests, endpoint came up, requests only from partner CIDR, no unexpected traffic. Scheduling prod apply tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Notifying oncall.

devops-bot: Deployment scheduled for 02:00 UTC — runbook: /runbooks/vpc-endpoint-apply.md (attached)

Riley: also add a CloudWatch metric filter and alert for spikes in 403 responses from the endpoint — helps catch misconfigs or unexpected principals.

Alicia P.: good call, added the metric filter and notif to the runbook.

Jamal: prod apply completed, endpoint healthy. Leaving SG locked to partner CIDR only.

Maya: Confirming compliance signoff post-deploy. Logging controls in place, partner contract noted.

Alicia P.: closing thread, thanks everyone. :tada:
